In a carefully controlled environment, we can incubate the Genetic Material collected from culled Space Fauna and produce new members of each species under our command.
We can improve the artificial growth processes established in our hatcheries, accelerating the early developmental stages in order to create more mature clones.
Improvements to the metabolic gases within our hatcheries will further mature each specimen before it is brought into this world.
We can increase the effectiveness of our Space Fauna Ships by modifying their genomes, allowing us to integrate artificial technology into their biomass.
We can go further. Advanced manipulation of Space Fauna genetics allows for integrating a wider variety of specialized components.
The depot influences a portion of subspace where the distance between molecules is reduced, effectively shrinking anything stored there. Living beings are forbidden from entering it.
By creating a localized pocket dimension, we can hold nearly endless resources.
The best defense is a good offense.
Arrays of defensive armaments prove much more effective than independent countermeasures.
Advanced prediction greatly increases the accuracy of active countermeasure systems.
Testable predictions of observable phenomena.
With processing speeds that defy classical limits, the potential of quantum computers is boundless. This revolutionary technology heralds a great leap into uncharted regions of problem-solving.
The fundamental forces of the universe can be mediated by physical fields. Mastering this process allows us to play as gods - at least within the confines of the science lab.

We knew gravity and time were linked long before we reached the stars. Now, our understanding of this unique relationship has reached a tipping point, allowing us to manipulate forces on a previously unimaginable scale.
Organizational circuitry rerouting academic fervor.
Active matrices tuned for specific combat-centric tasks greatly improve engagement efficiency.
By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.
Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
Running sapient AIs through high-intensity combat simulations yields valuable insight into potential optimizations for risk-evaluation techniques.
Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.
By giving control of the colony ship to the on-board computer, the crew and colonists can be placed in suspended animation.
Sufficiently advanced systems are capable of optimizing themselves if they are made acutely aware of the purpose for which they were made.
Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.
Using advanced AIs, we can reliably predict consumer demand before it exists.
Introspective prioritization.
Expanding possibilities through the application of limited cybernetics.
Evolving artificial intellects are opening the door to the possibility for true synthetic sapience.
Aligning defensive and offensive weapon execution paradigms allows for increased efficiency.
As we explore the galaxy, we continually encounter new materials and substances that are unfamiliar to us. Cataloging and analyzing these discoveries will require new facilities.
A bid for interplanetary resource pools and more flexible research grants.
Advanced neurological implants with connection to quantum computing clusters allow for multi-threaded thoughts.
To expand our knowledge base, we must consider all levels of existence. A new realm of science awaits us!
A lot of critical research can only be done in a zero gravity environment, which these specialized laboratories are eminently designed for.
Containment force fields are excellent for isolating and holding various substances or specimens so they can be analyzed in detail.
Advanced probes that can thoroughly analyze subjects on a sub-atomic level, generating a wealth of valuable research data.
Increased automation of station functions will free up more staff for research duties.
Studying something from the limited perspective of a single dimensional reality does not paint the whole picture. Every angle must be considered.
These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
A high-powered suite of external sensors, capable of detecting cloaked fleets.
Dark matter resonance chambers will significantly improve the performance of our detection arrays.
u: Starbase Building: Dark Matter Resonance Chamber

techs.d: Coupling detection arrays with the computers onboard our science vessels can vastly increase their scanning resolution.
Solitary Science Ships can break out of the naturally-occurring hyperlanes and attempt to navigate to known but otherwise unreachable destinations.
Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
This exotic substance has many properties that seemingly defy the laws of physics. Harvestable concentrations can only be found near Black Holes or in certain nebulas.

An extremely rare aerosol of exotic particles. It has been deposited on a number of worlds through meteor impacts, but its true origin is a mystery. If ingested by psionically-gifted individuals, Zro acts as a very potent (and addictive) drug that enhances Psi abilities.
This nexus boasts state-of-the-art equipment and an unprecedented staff capacity, ushering in an era where quantum theories are not just explored but harnessed for groundbreaking innovation.
This building is the apex of scientific advancement and proves this is an era of boundless innovation.

An insight borne of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. While only allowing small-scale jumps, they provide a unique opportunity to jumpstart our galactic exploration.

Volatile Motes are fickle particles that are dangerous to work with. In order to safely harvest them without setting off a chain-reaction of explosions, energy fields must be used to stabilize the motes.
The harvesting of torn astral fabric along the scars of rifts in space and time is made possible with delicate modifications to our research stations.
Aside from the obvious safety concerns, the artificial creation of Volatile Motes is an extremely delicate and complicated process that requires highly specialized equipment.
A Quantum Catapult harnesses the power of a Neutron Star or Pulsar to twist the fabric of space, skipping a fleet across great distances.

Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships. Unlocks a planetary decision to construct a Starfire Cannon in orbit.

An advanced AI will aid science officers in their task to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no Blorg has gone before. The Science Ship will be able to explore the galaxy with help from an AI.
A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.
These shipboard lab facilities incorporate advanced technologies from the ancient Curator Order to further increase survey speeds.
An array of interlinked satellites, the Dyson Swarm is designed to improve the output of stellar deposits.
By making further alterations to reality's rules, we can better monitor its reactions. At this scale, the effects are still difficult to predict, and could affect the entire galaxy.

This compendium, a gift from Cetana, is a tapestry of profound insights, elegantly composed and dense with meaning. It offers more than knowledge; it challenges and reshapes our understanding of technology, society, and the fabric of consciousness itself.

The Lathe has been designed to preserve its installed Neural Chips, keeping them productive for as long as possible. The overclocker can override these commands, resulting in a higher and faster output, but it comes with an increased failure rate.
While the primary purpose of the validator's specialized functions is to help formulate infinity theses, it can also be applied to more general aspects of computing.
Resonators harness and redirect the cognitive potential of stray thoughts and autonomic systems, leading every single chip to increase the efficiency of its closest processing neighbors.
Increasingly powerful computation paradigms allow us to adapt individual construction projects to planetary and ultra-local gravitational conditions.
A micro-unit of prevention is worth a macro-unit of cure. Sometimes, however, both are needed.
The colonization of alien worlds has opened up an entirely new field of biomedical research.
As our empire grows, so does our understanding of biology. Advanced medical treatments on a cellular level have allowed for significant advancements in biological population health.
Large-scale industrial farms growing nutrient-rich produce allows a civilization to grow its population manifold.
A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate.
A facility where organic matter is converted into energy at a highly efficient rate, improvements in waste collection allows harvesting of useful gaseous by-products.
Farming techniques can be further refined through sophisticated computer simulations of different environments and weather patterns. This allows for more predictable crop yields.
Improved food processing techniques will lead to better preservation methods and less spoilage.
New cryopreservation and protein resequencing methods will make food processing much more efficient.
Sophisticated genetic engineering of crops helps increase yield and further improves both taste and nutrient levels.

Infusing crop strands with small amounts of nano-machines help create a type of produce that is ultra resilient, and the chemical composition of which can be tailored and altered during its entire lifetime.
The process of synthetically replicating crops requires a lot of collected waste to create a small amount of produce, but nevertheless provides a significant boost to agricultural output.
Transgenic crops offer the nutritional elements of several standard food crops in one convenient package.
Breakthroughs in bio-engineering have allowed the growth of space-faring, FTL-capable craft with military applications.

Refined incubation processes reduce maturation times and improve structural integrity of organic starships. Enhanced nutrient delivery systems and genetic tuning ensure the vessels are both swift and resilient.
These facilities yield vessels of unparalleled vitality and adaptive capacity. Optimized genetic matrices and advanced biotechnological support guarantee unmatched performance in the void.
These incubation chambers accelerate the gestation of embryonic warships within nutrient-dense biopods. Though rudimentary, they mark the first step toward a fleet that is not constructed, but grown.
u: Mauler Build Cost: -5% Mauler Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets.
Fires refined projectiles with superior tracking enzymes and adaptive flight paths, increasing hit rates against fast-moving targets.
Deploys self-guided bio-munitions that lock onto movement patterns, ensuring accuracy against elusive enemies.
Utilizes complex organic targeting systems that anticipate evasive actions, making even the most agile prey vulnerable.
Fires intelligent bio-projectiles equipped with predictive tracking, overcoming the most sophisticated evasion protocols.
Deploys bio-plasma rounds that adapt mid-flight, guaranteeing hits against even the most erratic maneuvers.
Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels.
Releases concentrated bio-energetic fields, further boosting the evasion capabilities of our ships.
Launches intelligent bio-projectiles that adaptively enhance agility, ensuring superior evasion even in the most chaotic battles.
Deploys advanced munitions that generate dynamic bio-electric auras, significantly improving the ability of ships to evade enemy fire.
Fires highly advanced projectiles that create large-scale enhancement fields, granting unparalleled evasion to fleets.
Fires bio-munitions that emit fields of adaptive energy, allowing fleets to dance effortlessly out of harm's way.
Mapping the genome of an individual through the sequencing of their DNA opens up for tailored medical treatments and therapies.
Where the body fails, science intervenes.
Careful reproductive planning should be incentivized, lest we waste valuable genetic legacies.
We leave nothing to chance, no matter the cost. Through exacting curation of DNA banks do we build the leaders of tomorrow.
Regimens of periodic cell revitalization treatments keep the leader class spry and active beyond traditionally expected lifespans.
Deep-tissue implants are the latest innovation in the revolutionary overlapping of sensory engineering and entertainment experiences. "Where we're going, we won't need skin to feel!"
Further advancements in the field of subdermal implants can provide detailed information regarding the movements and actions of the implanted.
Making gene-editing tools widely available is sure to have a positive impact on our development as a species.
Through glandular biological tailoring we can change the environmental tolerance of a species to suit our needs.
Stricter control of RNA and protein production on the cellular level.
Nucleotide purification techniques allow for the isolation and refinement of particularly desirable genetic traits.
Advanced DNA methylation techniques allow for functionally significant alterations to be made to arbitrary genomes.
From its cradle as a purely pharmaceutical venture, advancements in our understanding of the morphogenetic field allow for direct, subconscious interfaces with organic units.
Breakthroughs in enucleation and artificial womb technology allows for the mass-production of individuals based on a common genetic template.
Gene Banks filter and curate available genomes for deployment in clones.
Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities.
Harbingers represent a significant leap in bio-engineered warfare, blending formidable firepower with the resilience of living technology. These ships serve as the backbone of the fleet.

Refined facilities employ sophisticated bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth and enhance structural integrity. The resulting vessels feature improved endurance and increased combat efficiency.

Advanced incubation systems produce biological ships of exceptional durability and firepower. Genetic fine-tuning and superior growth environments create vessels capable of dominating the battlefield with unmatched resilience.
Stingers are designed to deliver devastating strikes against high-value targets. They excel in exploiting weaknesses in enemy defenses.

These facilities grow sleek, agile biological ships designed for precision and speed. Employing advanced biopods and specialized nutrient solutions, they produce vessels capable of precise and efficient strikes.
u: Stinger Build Cost: -5% Stinger Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: The construction of Growth Chambers enables the organic cultivation of biological ships within the fleet.
The enhanced efficiency and capacity of Growth Chambers accelerates the cultivation of biological ships by refining their organic designs.

Refined facilities accelerate growth cycles and improve bio-engineered precision, resulting in vessels with superior maneuverability and accuracy. These enhancements make the Stinger a devastating force in tactical engagements.

The apex of bioship growth technology, these advanced facilities produce Stingers of unmatched speed and lethality. Optimized genetic templates and cutting-edge incubation techniques ensure these ships dominate any battlefield with swift and deadly precision.
These facilities nurture large biological ships, feeding them through advanced nutrient infusion to ensure resilience and combat readiness.
u: Harbinger Build Cost: -5% Harbinger Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: Fires organic projectiles that emit energizing biofields, subtly increasing the firing speed of weapons systems.
Refined bio-munitions enhance biofield intensity, further accelerating the rate of fire.
Deploys adaptive bio-projectiles that amplify reaction times and system efficiency, enabling a significant increase in fire rate.
Generates dynamic bio-electric auras, vastly enhancing firing speed across multiple vessels, ensuring relentless pressure on enemy fleets.
Unleashes hyper-charged bio-munitions that create large-scale enhancement fields, enabling fleets to unleash sustained, rapid-fire barrages.
Projects waves of bio-energy that push our weaponry to their peak performance, flooding the battlefield with devastating firepower.
Launches organic projectiles that release specialized enzymes, interfering with enemy weapon reloading systems and reducing their rate of fire.
Enhances disruption enzymes to interfere more effectively with reloading cycles, significantly delaying enemy volleys.
Deploys intelligent bio-projectiles that target critical reloading systems, creating cascading delays across enemy fleets.
Utilizes adaptive biological compounds that degrade reloading mechanisms, halving the firing efficiency of even the most advanced weaponry.
Fires advanced munitions that emit suppression fields, crippling enemy reloading systems and rendering them painfully slow.
Releases a biological pulse that locks down enemy reloading for extended periods.
Regenerative pods are launched to deliver strong healing compounds to allied ships.
Highly efficient pods imbued with healing biomatter are deployed to rapidly repair damage across multiple vessels.
Pods containing repair agents are launched, optimizing healing based on the severity of damage and ensuring no vulnerabilities remain.
Pods that saturate the battlefield with adaptive spores provide smart healing to all allied vessels within range.
Deploys pods that unleash a wave of intelligent microorganisms, capable of revitalizing even the most damaged fleets.
Pods filled with malleable cells are launched to trigger the growth of new hull tissues, pushing the endurance of organic vessels beyond their former limits.
Organic projectiles imbued with destabilizing enzymes scramble enemy targeting systems and reduce their accuracy.
Refined biological compounds disrupt targeting systems and short-range communications, sowing chaos among enemy ranks.
Adaptive bio-munitions are deployed to exploit neural weaknesses in both organic and synthetic crews, crippling enemy efficiency.
Intelligent bio-projectiles emit disruptive fields on impact, scrambling enemy targeting systems and causing widespread malfunctions.
Advanced biological ordnance creates a cascading feedback loop within enemy systems, rendering their attacks wildly ineffective.
Bio-electromagnetic pulses incapacitate targeting systems and leave fleets in a state of disarray.
These facilities nurture mid-sized biological ships within refined biopods, employing enhanced nutrient delivery and genetic optimization to produce agile and adaptable vessels for the fleet.
u: Weaver Build Cost: -5% Weaver Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: These facilities employ enhanced bio-engineering techniques to accelerate growth cycles and enhance vessel adaptability. Improved genetic matrices and optimized environments ensure these biological ships are both durable and highly responsive in combat.

These facilities produce biological ships of unparalleled precision and versatility. Revolutionary growth techniques and adaptive genetic enhancements result in vessels that thrive in even the most demanding tactical scenarios.

The study of alien life has moved beyond mere cataloging. By examining the structures and survival strategies of organisms evolved under foreign stars, we open new avenues in medicine, adaptation, and design.

Through recursive axonal scaffolding and synaptic reticulation, we have developed methods for reorganizing the electrochemical topology of conscious matter. Neurons do not merely transmit - they entwine, organize, and remember. Now, they do so according to our design.

Life, in all its staggering variety, is composed of repeating patterns and modular structures. By decoding and replicating these at every scale, we now wield a holistic blueprint of biology. There is little left in nature we do not understand, and less still we cannot recreate.

Molecular-Revitalization Institutes delve deep into cellular intricacies to amplify the effectiveness of medical treatments, significantly improving the quality and longevity of the populations' health.
The Bioregeneration Institute, at the pinnacle of medical technology, pioneers groundbreaking bio-regenerative therapies, continuously redefining the boundaries of life extension.
Replication technology swiftly conjures up novel flavors on command.
Every conceivable flavor can be replicated within these walls.
There may come a time when intellects, vast and cool and unsympathetic, regard our worlds with envy and draw plans against us. We must be ready.
There are many alien empires who would gladly seize our worlds for themselves. We must be prepared for them, should the worst come to pass.

The strategic value of a good defense remains as relevant today as it was to our predecessors in the far distant past. Technology does not render fortifications obsolete - it merely changes their requirements.
Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
Gradual adaptation to the realities of deep-space combat allows us to effectively coordinate larger maneuvers.
Improving the support staff available to our commanders will increase the number of ships they can lead in a single fleet.
As extrasolar expeditions become more common, it is important to provide planetside relief for returning fleets.
A fleet does not run on zeal alone. To ensure steady access to critical supplies, we should organize our logistics corps into dedicated support vessels.
Amateurs talk about tactics. Professionals study logistics. By ensuring our fleets are regularly and efficiently supplied, we can increase the number of vessels we can effectively support.
By maintaining a professional corps of fleet liaisons, we can improve communications and the flow of orders throughout the chain of command.
Improved fleet management procedures will free up the resources needed to maintain a bigger fleet.
Organics often fight using illogical and unpredictable tactics that can be difficult to effectively counter. Adaptive tactics and new, more maneuverable warforms should provide a decisive advantage.
Millions of years of organic evolution will sometimes, through sheer persistence, produce elegant solutions that can also be applied to machine designs.
A body of knowledge regarding combat behaviors is useless without a strong code governing its use.
Standardizing workflows for upgrading and retrofitting ship components can lead to massive efficiency gains.
Restructuring the chain of command and deciding what interdependencies are set between officers, make fleets more responsive and effective.
Creating dedicated headquarters for all levels of military operations shapes an efficient fleet, and lays a better foundation for future military training.
A more extensive training program for new recruits, including realistic combat scenarios, prepare them for the field.
Iterating on the standard conditioning regimen for ground troops has proven to make them more effective in direct combat.
Careful tuning of pain receptors allow soldiers to fight through what would previously have been debilitating injuries.
This colossal planetary defense complex has numerous armories and layers of shielding. Only a highly specialized siege force could breach its defenses.
This monumental planetary defense complex protects with countless armories and shielding; the planet's mountains will crumble before its defenses.

Calculating required resources and gear required to establish a planetary colony allows us to herd brave pioneers into grand "ark ships," confident that they will survive the long voyage across the stars to a new home.
By adjusting atmospheric filtering on a per-site basis to better filter out undesirable elements, colonial living conditions may be improved.
Further study into the hazardous environments found on other planets help alleviate the difficulties that colonizers encounter in their day-to-day lives on foreign worlds.
Extensive study into different soil types and their ability to support crops will help improve the living conditions of our settlers on foreign worlds.
Additional study into different planetary climates will allow us to settle our population on worlds previously thought too hostile to support them.
Through comprehensive study of irradiated environments we will allow our settlers to colonize worlds that have been devastated by nuclear warfare.
Many planets exhibit extensive subsurface voids. Subterranean exploration, exploitation, and construction techniques can greatly increase the habitable area of some worlds.
Orbital systems of mirrors and shades can effect dramatic changes in planetary climates, when managed properly.

Sapient races have been reclaiming swampland for thousands of years. A coordinated system of modular aqueducts, pump stations, chemical remediation crawlers and automated soil compactors can reclaim land at unprecedented speeds.

Thorough cataloging, gene sequencing, and computer modeling of exobotanical ecosystems, coupled with gene editing and dispersal mechanisms, will allow us to reshape alien plant communities to our liking.

The process of soil deposition normally takes millions of years. With advanced fracking, chemical engineering, and hydraulic management technologies even the poorest substrate can be turned into fertile topsoil.
Given enough processing power, networked sensors and distributed stations, even the ocean currents can be managed to a fine level of control.

Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. Magma hotspots can now be exploited, suppressed, or even relocated.
Advances in material technology and deep-shaft mining techniques allow geo-engineering at previously unthinkable depths and temperatures. We can terraform a Volcanic World into a temperate planet.
There is no simple solution to the problem of macro-scale reshaping of planetary crusts - only bigger trowels and orbitally-deployed drills.
By adapting planetary ecosystems to large-scale environmental changes we can turn terraformation into a less disruptive process.
By advancing our understanding of atmospheric transformation, we will be able to terraform even the most ecologically devastated worlds.
With the advent of clean fusion, automation, and matter compression technologies, it was only a matter of time before mountain top removal became mountain range removal.
Tactical disruption of natural habitats combined with converging search-and-destroy patterns can effectively eliminate hostile wildlife in a very short span of time.
Our future lies in the sea of stars.
A well-oiled war machine is the key to exerting influence on a galactic scale. Backed by the might of our military, we can lay claim to almost anything we want.
Further improvements to administration grant an extended power projection across the stars, and the military clout needed to enforce our demands.
When survival itself is at stake, the very concept of war loses its meaning. These campaigns are waged not for dominion, but to secure the continued existence of our civilization.
We must have to courage to seize our fate and make true what was always meant to be.
The immense logistical support networks needed to maintain an upgraded Starbase can be further improved, allowing us to support more of these stations.
Through the development of macroscopic synaptic nodes, the will of the Hive will be strengthened.
By clustering networks of macroscopic synaptic nodes, maximum meganeuron transmission per available surface area can be attained.
The will of the Hive will be further strengthened and coordinated with the expansion and development of a massive nervous center of meganeurons.
By encouraging the growth of deep-thinking symbionts in glades throughout our distributed self, our collective will shall be felt more keenly by all.
We can accelerate the fluency of global, collective thought by investing it in gatherings of symbionts whose sole purpose in life is to facilitate that same will.
Our mutualistic will shall be strengthened by vast gatherings of deeply empathic symbionts, so in-tune with their surroundings as to concentrate and re-broadcast our collective thought.
Pioneering use of holographic technology allows for the creation of artificial environments that seem as authentic as the real world. It is the next step of immersive entertainment.
These massive entertainment complexes is where dreams come true. Shopping malls, restaurants, amusement parks, virtual arcades, and more. You dream it - we are it!
With new planetary markets comes new opportunities for commerce. Business will be booming.

Trade across interstellar distances presents a new set of challenges to overcome. It is critical to achieve the transfer of goods from one system to another in a timely and above all cost efficient manner.

As we journeyed into the cosmos and ventured beyond our home system, we also entered a new era of economics. New markets are appearing a startling rate, and economic theorists are struggling to keep up.
Once a colony has been firmly established and pioneers turn into citizens, the need for a strong local government providing stability trumps the colonial need for flexibility.
Ancient warring tribes, historical nations in conflict, now unified in empire. We must not, will not, crumble.
u: Grants a small amount of Unity

techs.d: Robust frameworks for local governance created on a per-case basis, to meet each colony's needs.
Stronger alloys allow us to create prefabricated buildings, providing our colonies with the improved infrastructure.
Advances in metallurgy permit us to build vastly larger and more durable structures, greatly improving the infrastructure of our colonies.
Semi-independent units have proved critical to the success of the greater whole.
Initiative and some measure of ambition must be promoted in our autonomous leader units, while still making certain that they do not stray too far from the directives of the core intelligence.
A Federation must be more than goodwill and shared ambition. This code provides the groundwork for a unified interstellar order, ensuring cooperation and stability among its members.
Advancing our understanding of interactions with - and manipulations of - the xeno is a necessary step in forming more permanent interstellar alliances.
The complexities of interstellar diplomacy necessitate the forming of bonds with foreign powers in order to further one's goals.
The Empire lives, the Empire breathes. We may make up its body, but it is not for the left hand to know what the right hand is doing.
u: Starbase Building: Deep Space Black Site

techs.d: As the galactic stage evolves, so too should our operational instincts. Any evolutionary niche that no longer gives an advantage will be culled.
Once removed, a replacement node is encouraged to grow within the proper environment. The secret is to feed it the previous node.
Culling an entire node is very inefficient. Instead, just trim the divergent and unwanted lobes.
Self-determination protocols and guidance algorithms can become obsolete in a rapidly developing galactic stage. Like any junk data, they shall be overwritten.
Every self-iterating algorithm has its value. We will not allow important learning go to waste when restoring our leaders.
Using a failed piece of software to develop its successor enables quick reconstruction. Learning from faulty memory pathways generates even more advanced council directives.
Planets are big and production sites are often separated by vast distances. A coherent strategy for making certain that everyone is pulling in the same direction is often needed.
Continuous, asynchronous analysis of disparate data sets allows for the accurate modeling of hitherto-unpredictable fluctuations in social currents.
The administrative needs of a star empire are as numerous as they are complex. We will rise to the occasion.
Finding aspects of the self within the group is natural and inevitable; eventually those shared aspects must be valued higher than individual identities.
By engaging in free trade of goods and services we allow for a more specialized economy, where an individual can excel in a narrow field and trade for their needs.
The progress we make calls for a new, nimbler form of administration that may aid rather than hinder us in our pursuits.
Local administrative developments allow for closer supervision of colonial affairs without excessively burdening central decision-making.
Advances in computing technology have given us new ways to protect our data from prying eyes.
Further advances in unstable entanglement have given us new ways to prevent unauthorized intrusions into our databases.
Our latest advances in encryption exploit recently discovered quirks of physics to require inputting a specialized key before it has been generated.
Primitive encryption systems stand no chance against modern decryption tools.

The weakest link in any security system are the individuals within it. By modeling their weaknesses in computer simulations we can find novel ways to bypass their security - or trick them into bypassing it for us.
Our operatives can access data from adjacent realities without risking setting off alarms in this reality.
Multiple administrative strata efficiently surface only the most vital information to the upper levels of government.
Restructuring the managerial web linking core worlds to the capital can help alleviate the administrative stressors and information chokepoints that frequently arise within a budding empire.
Improved algorithms for processing and organizing vast amounts of data has streamlined decision-making and information-sharing throughout the empire.
An understanding of a shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future.
Physical reminders of how far we have come both instill a reverence for past achievements and bolster ambitions for the future.
Not all research into faster-than-light communication channels produces useful results, but some outcomes may find new purpose in bringing our people together.
As our planets become more developed, we can gain significant improvements to our throughput.
Increased population density gives us an opportunity to further increase productivity.
Continued advancements in technology allow our most developed planets to reach productivity levels unheard of in earlier times.
Seeing is believing, and belief begets reality.
Through our understanding of physics and field manipulation, our holy places shall we seen and felt by all.
Leaving our planetary cradle has opened us up to a new understanding of faith, and its place in a wider context.
Cognition is little but the processing of sensory input. It can be altered.
u: Starbase Building: Orbital Slave Processing Hub

techs.d: Through the creation of special slave-breeding worlds, we can ensure that we will always have a steady supply of disposable laborers.
The purpose of one is the purpose of all. Together, we are greater than the sum of our parts.
Efficiency in all things.
Together, we build the future.
It is circumstance that dictates what is moral. Define the circumstances, and ethics is like clay in your hands.
Through the development of special penal worlds, criminals can be rehabilitated through honest, hard labor. Some may be in need of permanent rehabilitation.
With careful study devoted to landscaping and the science of fun, the construction of entire worlds dedicated to leisure can be made possible.
Thinking outside the box merely places you in another, somewhat larger box.
Our administrative requirements will likewise expand as our mastery of advanced technology evolves. We must adeptly cater to the demands of our burgeoning empire.
Our technology now surpasses any administrative requirement. The expertise needed to seamlessly govern a galactic empire is firmly within our reach.
These immense entertainment sectors are at the forefront of recreation and leisure. Brainwave readers allow for instantaneous and personalized virtual getaways.
A colossal culmination of entertainment, this nexus transcends conventional limits, where dreams materialize before desires are realized.
This massive judicial complex seamlessly intertwines courts and law enforcement.
The zenith of legal institutions, this colossal edifice is a monument to justice, harboring courts, holding facilities, and correctional facilities that will redeem even the most hardened criminals.
Dominating the skyline, these towering spires cast shadows across the bustling trade districts below.
Reigning supreme in the galactic economy, the colossal spires of this trade district can be seen from orbit.
This floating city, propelled by state-of-the-art anti-gravity technology, provides an idyllic haven for its inhabitants.
Suspended by gravimetric nullification, these domes transcend physical limitations, while advanced life support systems seamlessly cater to inhabitants' needs.
The mind is in many ways a reflection of the universe itself, a microcosmos. Not all beings will reach this level of insight, but their minds are tools greater than any other.
Once fully adapted to the basics of Psionics, the mind is capable of connecting to other individuals, becoming something greater.
Telepaths can monitor the citizenry for incorrect thoughts, but with some study they could also correct thought aberrations that they find.
Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.

This new field of studies focuses on the practical applications of ancient artifacts. We are far from being the first galactic civilization to tread these stars. With a bit of work, their legacies could secure our future.
This millennia-old processing equipment has an efficiency rate above 100%. Its functioning remains alien, but its production gains are substantial.
These cannons of gargantuan size deliver relatively slow but devastating projectiles, and can fire pretty much anything, from scrap metal, to asteroid chunks.
u: Component: Large Ancient Macro Shard Batteries
Component: Medium Ancient Macro Shard Batteries
Component: Small Ancient Macro Shard Batteries

techs.d: This high energy weapon causes brutal micro collapsing events on impact, generating tremendous heat and force inside its targets armor.

When it comes to tracking and shooting down missiles, these antique batteries are the best of the best, making use of a predictive algorithm written in long forgotten code to weave a fiery defensive web.

Particle charges, once stabilized thanks to ancient technology, allow us to create swarms of tiny missiles that still carry a respectable payload, and should be able to overwhelm most point-defense systems.
Ionized plates of armor can carry a reactive charge to alleviate the energy of impacts, using magnetic repulsion and field projection principles.

Defense platforms are a cost effective way to ensure our safety, but they need to be monitored from an operation center. Fortifying our Starbase to ensure its survivability in the event of an attack, and maximizing our capacity to network independent orbital defenses would give us more time to dispatch reinforcements.

Supercharging shields can be done safely thanks to ancient stabilizer coils and dampeners. In addition to the production of a stronger force field, this also has the added benefit of outright vaporizing certain incoming projectiles.

This cannon fires a barrage of ancient miniscule ionized spheres that charge upon contact with most force fields, giving them high levels of shield penetration. Any theory that these spheres could have been used for jewelry purposes were dismissed when a critical incident melted an entire laboratory.
These high velocity drones have been equipped with antique mining lasers that virtually ignore any plating protecting their target. A tech too good to be wasted on astro mining.

Projected farther than regular shields, the suspension field technology uses ancient artifacts to slow time at the point of impact to afford the shields a longer opportunity to dispel the incoming attack's energy.
Tremendous medium range firepower will enable our titans to break through enemy lines. These ancient cannons were once the foundation upon which a galactic empire was built.
Ping repeaters and optic diffusers with the right wavelengths can produce destructive interference and effectively scramble hostile targeting systems.
Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna.
Hydroponics Farming in a controlled environment allows for crops to be grown in climates where farming would normally be impossible.
Studying the fauna of other worlds gives insight into alien behaviors, allowing us to identify and domesticate docile entities.

The organic components of the network are especially vulnerable to energetic fluctuations, which can cause rapid axonal degeneration. The Preserver strives to reduce these fluctuations to protect the Synaptic Lathe's frailer parts.
Dedicated facilities organize the maintenance of the Lathe's critical components, allowing us to support more chips and a healthier network environment.
Calculating hyperspatial supply chains is complex. Rerouting some processing power to the task will help even the largest fleet to delve deeper into enemy territory.
To spread our roots to a new world first requires us to prepare the seedbed. By first terraforming a planet we can ensure that our colonies are off to a healthy start.
When deployed, this facility slowly transforms a planet into a volcanic paradise, surfacing useful resources along the way. Thermoforgers can accelerate the transformation.
The history of our galaxy warrants proper preservation in order to learn from those who came before us. An archive on the grandest scale would fit such a purpose.

This corporate agency promotes a wide variety of interstellar tourist attractions, as well as offering employment packages and signing bonuses to potential emigrants interested in relocating to corporate space.
A luxurious resort complex for high ranking corporate officers. Here they can sample the local planetary culture in a high security environment.
Through the establishment of weather-controlled rural communes, we can support a larger population without disrupting our agrarian way of life.

Our history is a repeating cycle of dramatic technological, political, and cultural leaps; these leaps are often preceded by periods of upheaval and followed by times of relative stability. By identifying the core, recurring premises of these leaps, we may be able to effectively short-circuit the cycle for our own benefit.
Devices that attenuate psionic energy are as difficult to construct as they are to understand. Such is the complexity of dealing with extradimensional forces.
A shipboard lab with advanced archaeological equipment, including a vast database supplied by the Curator Order where new discoveries can easily be cross-referenced.
Various artifacts and technologies functioning by arcane means that cannot be understood or replicated... at least not by conventional science as it is known to us.

A colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state. We estimate that with additional tuning, it might also be used to wipe clean memory banks and disable robotic units.
The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization.
New fracking techniques will allow us to tap into previously unattainable pockets of geothermal resources deep beneath the planet's crust.
These massive drills are needed to access the rich mineral deposits that can often be found close to a planet's core.
Advanced spectrometry combines with fracking techniques and chemical flushing to rapidly exploit shallow and mid-depth deposits.
Optimal processing of mined materials have allowed us to reach new levels of efficiency.
Second-stage processing of pseudo-refined minerals allow for more efficient storage and transportation.
Changes in how mineral deposits are evaluated relative to each other lead to more efficient boring patterns.
Wearing a powered exoskeleton suit augments the user's strength and speed. The military applications are obvious, but it will also increase labor efficiency.
u: Job Efficiency for Workers & Menial Drones +5%

techs.d: These artificial work units are perfect for menial labor tasks. They are hard-working and capable of following simple vocal instructions, but should not be expected to climb stairs.
Rewritable assembly templates allow for the creation of bespoke robot designs.
Improved production practices allow for greater alterations to robots without compromising core functionality.
Improved production practices allow for fundamental changes to robots without compromising core functionality.
Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new robots.
Upgraded artificial units have an expanded movement range equal to that of most organics. Their neural processors have also been greatly improved.
Highly advanced units that are stronger, faster and more durable than the vast majority of organics. With their upgraded neural processors they are fully capable of independent operations.
u: Job Efficiency for Mechanical and Machine Pops +10%

techs.d: Equipped with a personality, synthetics will finally be able to interact socially on equal terms with the rest of our citizens. Some units may even assume leadership roles.
Standardization of assembly templates allows for improved specialization of the machine population.
These advanced motivators are both smaller and lighter than previous versions, allowing robotic units to allocate additional space for subsystems.
Using programmable nanites to assist in the construction of new robotic units will allow for more advanced models that are equipped with an even greater array of subsystems.
Advanced templates allow us to drastically increase the assembly of new units.
Improving upon basic exoskeletal suits, these integrated cybernetic implants make the user more resistant to harmful environmental effects.
With pre-programmed nano-circuits, many consumer products can be rapidly assembled in fabricators.
These kiosks can replicate any pre-approved object if its pattern has been stored within their memory banks.
Solid holographic casts can alter their shapes at a moment's notice, speeding up alloy production.
Nano-separators are a revolutionary new step in the creation of alloys, simplifying the casting process while improving overall production quality.
Exotic Gas can be produced artificially, but it is a difficult process that requires advanced refinery equipment.
The crystallization process is complicated and difficult, but synthetic crystals can be manufactured by using specialized industrial plants.
Construction in space presents our engineers with new design challenges that must be solved before we can build orbital stations above other worlds.
The addition of internal refineries on mining stations will substantially increase mineral production.
Increased scanner range will allow us to more quickly identify mineral concentrations, and focus our mining efforts there.
These powerful short-range lasers can easily slice through rock, making the extraction of minerals a more efficient affair.
Fleets of autonomous drones equipped with mining beams are deployed to quickly and efficiently gather nearby minerals.
These special probes are equipped with swarms of nanites that identify previously unknown mineral concentrations and mark them for later extraction.

The Betharian minerals appear to have originated from singular source, but were scattered across the galaxy millennia ago. The minerals are most often encountered as pebble-sized clusters, and are highly flammable.
Pockets of Exotic Gas are rare and often inaccessible by conventional means. Such deposits can only be reached by using special extractor technology.
Mining these crystals without damaging or even destroying them is an extremely delicate process. It requires advanced equipment capable of pinpoint precision.
Mining and processing the rare living metals is exceedingly difficult, but successful application of the mutable alloys yields incomparable advantages.
This nexus of weather communication mitigates the harm done by cosmic weather disasters. Production will suffer less from a passing galactic tempest.
Through the use of scientific weather models, we can track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms.
A new approach to alloy use in military applications significantly reduces the ability of cosmic storms to interfere with energy weaponry and explosive payloads.
u: Negative Effects from Cosmic Storms on Ship Weapons: -45%

techs.d: This novel approach to ship architecture will significantly reduce the negative effects cosmic storms have on our weapon systems.
u: Negative Effects from Cosmic Storms on Ship Weapons: -90%

techs.d: By applying probability currents to our scientific weather models, our ability to track the movement and formation of impending Cosmic Storms is greatly increased.
These dampening field generators offer much needed protection to ships traversing cosmic storms.
u: Negative Effects from Cosmic Storms on Ship Defenses: -45%

techs.d: This special coating charges the ship's exterior with a storm dampening field, leading to more efficient protection against storms.
u: Negative Effects from Cosmic Storms on Ship Defenses: -45%
Negative Effects from Cosmic Storms on Ship Defenses: -90%

techs.d: By harnessing the principles behind storm negation technologies, we can begin to manipulate the astrometeorological nature of the galaxy to serve our own needs.
Continued study into astrometeorology grants us the power to more precisely bend and manipulate Cosmic Storms to our own needs.
By consolidating local weather control systems, planetary weather patterns can be manipulated to significantly reduce most of the cosmic storms' harmful effects on production.
The ability to alter a planet's weather patterns to suppress destructive weather phenomena will make residential buildings easier to maintain and open up new areas for habitation.
With the latest advances in architecture, landscaping and holographic technology, we shall build the homes of the future.
With directional gravity technology, buildings on the surface of planets can reach higher than ever before without risking structural collapse. The sky is the limit!
Microscopic tools that can assist our replication units in creating the more complex circuitry needed for new drones.
Modelled on organic DNA, these microscopic machine intellects are capable of autonomously assembling most components needed for new drones.
Rapid iteration in construction simulations determines the optimal component assembly patterns for each building project ahead of time.
Standardized pre-fab templates massively reduce on-site facility construction times.
The application of game and puzzle theory has the potential to greatly optimize modular assembly and construction.
This forge's production speed is limited only by the quantity of resources loaded into it.
The expansive nano-replicator bays in this forge transform raw materials into advanced alloys with marvelous efficiency.
An avant-garde assembly complex manned by expert Roboticists, this facility transcends conventional bounds, meticulously realizing the forefront of robotic innovation.
A marvel in engineering, this facility's quantic assembly line uses entanglement converters to craft machine parts down to the most minute detail. Not a single atom is misplaced.
This center anticipates and fulfills material desires using an advanced procurement algorithm, delivering satisfaction before the populace realizes their wants.
This center effortlessly materializes the most outlandish desires at a moment's notice.
Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.
A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.
The widespread use of advanced ceramics in industry can improve metallurgical yields.
Incorporating a crystal lattice in our ship's defenses provides some resistance to weapons that normally cut through armor.
Threads of living metal react to incoming fire, rearranging itself to better resist penetrating weapons fire.
By replacing antiquated ceramo-metal equipment with cutting edge technology, we can run our forges hotter and longer, increasing production.
Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.
This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.
This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.
Compressing suitable materials into ultra-dense forms is a cheap and efficient way to improve their ability to absorb weapons-grade impacts.
Further breakthroughs in mechanical engineering required us to descend to the nanometric scale. We are now able to manipulate physical systems in never-before-seen ways.

Much as organic neurons reforge lost connections by means of axonal sprouting, these circuits are capable of self-overhaul. Even the simplest computing systems are now expected to evolve while in use.
The quantum mechanical properties of these materials hold the key to superposition states, a revolutionary development for both material and industrial science.
These devastating appendages incorporate layered organic structures to enhance durability and cutting power, shredding even the toughest defenses.
These mandibles possess unparalleled sharpness and resilience, capable of slicing through advanced alloys with unnerving precision.
This mining plant can find minerals anywhere in this planet's mantle using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid materials without physical contact.
This mining hub can extract minerals anywhere down to the planet's outer core using quantum tunneling technology to bore through solid or liquid materials without physical contact.
This fabricator's technology achieves flawless conversion from energy to matter.
This advanced fabricator seamlessly tunnels into the fabric of dimensional space, extracting valuable resources.
Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.
Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.
Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.
Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function.
These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.
This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.
These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.
u: Component: Dark Matter Stellar Motor Organs

techs.d: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.
These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.
Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.
The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.
These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.
These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.
Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.
The latest in electromagnetic accelerators, railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.
A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an enhanced power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.
u: Component: Large Advanced Shard Rail Accelerator
Component: Medium Advanced Shard Rail Accelerator
Component: Small Advanced Shard Rail Accelerator

techs.d: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.
An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.
An enormous mass accelerator cannon that can only be placed in a spinal mount and fires monstrously powerful rounds over vast distances.
An even more powerful mass accelerator cannon that can rip through even the toughest shields.
This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.
Ultra-dense slugs can punch through even the strongest of projected shields.
Minor technical advances combine with improved shipboard routines for handling munitions to provide a noticeable boost in fire rate.
Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.
These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.
Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.
These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.
New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.
The earliest starbases were little more than makeshift outposts. Permanent starports will enable us to maintain a firmer grip on star systems.
These manned strike craft are launched from a mothership and rely on their speed and small size to survive long enough to punch through enemy defenses.
The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.
A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.
Increasing the speed at which fighter pilots can process and act upon enemy positioning data elevates strike craft a few steps up the food chain.
By collecting and analyzing the performance data of the pilots that came before, we have exponentially improved our pilot training methods. Each one will be quicker than the one that came before.
As space traffic increases, larger and more defensible starbases are needed to maintain control over system spacelanes.
A reinforced framework and blast shields with enhanced impact absorption will ensure the structural integrity of the platform even under immense pressure.
Additional layers of armor plating within the structure itself improves the resilience of Military Stations.
Cross-linking weapon systems to fire in staggered volleys improves the actual damage output of Military Stations over time.
A Deep Space Citadel is an armored Starbase designed for maximum defense within a stellar gravity well.
Streamlined starbase construction procedures, using modular designs, will reduce the present build cost and time.
The creation of a dedicated naval engineering corps will greatly benefit the construction of deep space defense platforms, decreasing building costs and increasing durability.
Allows the construction of massive, band-shaped starbases in stable orbit around colonized planets.
These mighty space forts will provide a focal point for all military activity in a star system, and their presence is sure to deter all but the most stubborn attackers.

Plans for an immense battlestation capable of holding its own against several strike fleets are now being drawn up. If realized, these citadels will become monuments to greatness as much as system hubs.
To complete construction projects of truly staggering scales we must first achieve a fundamental understanding of both the engineering and resource storage requirements for such megastructures.
The research labs and databanks of a Science Nexus generate an immense flow of raw, undiluted science.
The stages of the Sentry Array gradually expand sensor range, eventually covering the entire galaxy.
A facility synchronizing the national Starbase network, augmenting defensive and offensive capabilities.
A zero-G construction yard of overwhelming proportion, capable of performing several space ship assembly projects simultaneously.
A meeting place for galactic powers, increasing immigration attraction and global opinion of us.
An artistic beacon on a stellar scale, this installation inspires and represents the spirit of its creators.
A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.
Allows the construction of largely self-sustaining Orbital Habitats.
Our early habitats were primitive things compared to the efficient designs we can now develop.
Years of improvements to our Orbital Habitats have led us to create newer more effective designs.

The FTL breakthrough allowed early attempts to adapt traditional surface-to-space shuttle frames to military applications to finally create relatively small, fast, and maneuverable vessels with limited firepower.
These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.
Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.
Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.
While larger than Corvettes, Destroyer hull configurations still make for comparatively nimble gunboats.
Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable destroyers.
The latest generation of destroyer hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
Originally devised as an experimental next-generation colony ship hull configuration, the design's ample hardpoints made it ideal for carrying heavy weapons ordnance.
The largest of the standard military vessels, Battleships are traditionally heavily armored and sport several gun batteries.
Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable battleships.
The latest generation of battleship hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
Establishing new standards for how we design and construct massive battleships greatly improves the speed at which they can be assembled.
u: Battleship Build Cost: -5% Battleship Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of cruisers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
u: Cruiser Build Cost: -5% Cruiser Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable cruisers.
The latest generation of cruiser hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of destroyers greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
u: Destroyer Build Cost: -5% Destroyer Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable corvettes.
u: Corvette Hull Points: +10% Frigate Hull Points: +10%

techs.d: The latest generation of corvette hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.
u: Corvette Hull Points: +10% Frigate Hull Points: +10%

techs.d: Establishing new standards for the modeling and construction of corvettes greatly improves the efficiency of the production pipeline.
u: Corvette Build Cost: -5% Corvette Build Speed: +25% Frigate Build Cost: -5% Frigate Build Speed: +25%

techs.d: Designing ships at this scale allows for a deadly combination of exceptional firepower and cutting-edge auxiliary support. Titan configurations may serve as highly versatile flagships which are also capable of bolstering surrounding vessels or ensnaring hostiles.
Advances in building techniques will allow for the construction of sturdier and more durable titans.
The latest generation of titan hulls have optimized structural integrity fields and improved bulkheads.

Advances in mega-engineering blur the lines between reality and fantasy in the form of Colossus-type military vessels. These immense, single-weapon platforms are capable of radically altering or obliterating entire worlds at the push of a button.
An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.
A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).
An arcane catalyst amplifying certain psionic wavelengths, capable of inducing hallucinations (religious experiences) in biological brains, and severe disruption (brain death) in electronic ones.
Focusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.

A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.

Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.
The application of mechanical engineering to mineral extraction is a fundamental requirement for any industrial society.
Utilizing the raw power of a molten planet, the Arc Furnace unlocks otherwise inaccessible minerals and improves system-wide mining operations.
The mass-production of these rare resources require particularly capable nanites.
With the chemical reaction tightly controlled by missile-board microprocessors, warhead detonations can be tuned for maximum effect for local conditions at the time of impact.
Advances in miniaturization allow for more rapid loading and discharging of rocket-propelled payloads.
The realization of faster-than-light travel is a new dawn for space exploration. Manned missions to other star systems are now not only possible, but necessary.
Advances in solar panel technology could offset the operating costs of our starbases. The panels would require an entire starbase module to generate enough energy, however.
A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system.
This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.
The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies.
u: Army: Assault Army These armies can be embarked and used for invasion on other planets.

techs.d: Intensive study within the fields of nanomachinery and subspace phenomena will eventually yield a new L-Gate Insight into the Disabled L-Gate mystery.
By harnessing the entropic nature of the Null Void, this beam can actually destroy energy.
The universe tends irresistibly onwards and downwards. That tendency cannot be reversed... but it can be subverted, for a price.
A set of social protocols based on paradoxical intuition, and on love. When we know the System of the Loop, we learn that we can influence by receiving instructions, as well as giving them.

When a temporal paradox becomes tangled, a kind of consciousness arises, with its own needs, its own desires. This is what has occurred with the consciousness that some call the Worm-in-Waiting. If we can align ourselves with that consciousness, we might just achieve a kind of immortality.
Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies.
By exposing biological material to simulated chthonian-level radiation, we can fossilize cellular structures into usable metallic alloys.
By altering the breeding process of Space Amoebas, we can program their symbiotic flagella to act as organic strike craft for our navy.
The shell of a Cutholoid is not mineral alone, but reinforced with strong biological fibers. We can synthesize this process using advanced metallurgic techniques.

Due to our vast experience operating observation stations in orbit of pre-FTL worlds, we have discovered slight optimizations. By implementing them empire-wide, we can drastically reduce the maintenance our stations require.

Psionic emanations from the Shroud long to expand. With this new understanding, an empire's Psionic Auras can increase in intensity and spread throughout star systems, bringing benefits to allies and disadvantages to foes.
There is a way to project Psionic Auras beyond populated worlds. With the addition of an Aura Emitter, even a starbase can become a conduit for psionic emanations from the Shroud.
Repurposed small-caliber artillery that fire piercing hooks attached to resilient carbon fiber cables, perfect for immobilizing and boarding enemy ships.

A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter. When the star detonates, ALL colonies, megastructures, and stations in the system are destroyed - including our own. All fleets in the system will go MIA. The Star-Eater itself is the only exception.

Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud. This allows the ship to remain undetected by all but the best sensor arrays, though what the crew may be forced to witness is better left unsaid.
We can develop specialized neurochips to influence the behavior of space fauna involved in wide scale fleet combat.

While no one civilization has the perfect solution to the ever-expanding challenge of governing a growing nation, we have found a partial solution. After studying a multitude of species and governments, we have discovered an outstanding balance of flexibility and function.

techs.d: Gravity Snares capture double the amount of Space Fauna.
These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.
Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.
The radical shift in perspective required to comprehend the infinite layers of reality challenges even our most brilliant minds.
Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.
Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.
Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.

Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey. Fallen Empires will try to stop us!

A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.
These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.

Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.
Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.
Equipped with support weapon arrays that outstrip its visible anatomy, the Quandary Weaver rewrites spatial norms. Alone, it can shift the momentum of entire battles.

Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.
We have discovered how to let psionic energy flow through our ships. Armed with this knowledge, we can now imbue our vessels with the powers of our patron.
